questions.q: What is a system prompt, as covered in this lesson?
options: A message that shapes the model's behavior across every turn of a conversation, rather than a single request
An error message the model returns when it fails
The first user message typed into a chat window
A setting that controls how fast the model generates tokens
questions.explain: A system prompt sits above the conversation and sets role, tone, rules, and boundaries for the whole conversation, set once rather than every turn.

questions.q: Why is "You are a helpful assistant" considered a weak system prompt?
options: It is too long for most models to process
It's already close to the model's default behavior and gives it no real new information
It is grammatically incorrect
It uses a forbidden word that triggers a content filter
questions.explain: The phrase doesn't specify a role, scope, boundary, or rule — it's not wrong, just empty of anything the model couldn't already assume.

questions.q: In the lesson's strong system prompt example, what does the escalation rule do?
options: Tells the model to hand off billing disputes to a human rather than attempt to resolve them
Tells the model to always answer every question regardless of topic
Increases the model's maximum reply length for billing questions
Instructs the model to guess at account details when unsure
questions.explain: The example system prompt explicitly instructs the model to escalate billing disputes to a human instead of trying to handle them.

questions.q: According to this lesson, which of the following belongs in the user message rather than the system prompt?
options: A hard boundary on what the assistant should never do
The assistant's role and persona
A one-off detail like today's date or a specific order number
A default rule that applies to every single turn of the conversation
questions.explain: One-off, turn-specific details belong in the user message; role, persona, and standing rules belong in the system prompt.

questions.q: What does this lesson say is the actual job of a system prompt?
options: To pre-script the exact wording of every possible reply the model might give
To set the role and the boundaries, not to anticipate every possible question
To replace the need for any user messages at all
To list every topic the model is allowed to discuss, with no exceptions ever
questions.explain: A system prompt that tries to pre-script every reply becomes unreadable and hard to maintain; its real job is setting role and boundaries.
